summary.text: Chris Balkema was sworn into the Illinois Senate in January 2025 and represents the 53rd District.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, he previously served on the Grundy County Board, chairing it since 2016, and worked 31 years at Caterpillar.
He holds a B.S. in Business Systems from Taylor University and an MBA from Bradley University, and lives in Channahon.
